gen-fs-britney-fs-synonym: Britney writes in a tight, calligraphic hand, relaxed and expressive. Synonym lays down a plain sans-serif stripe beneath it, so the script gets the spotlight and the text keeps things steady, though it isn't meant for long paragraphs.
gen-fs-britney-nunito-sans: Relaxed, that's Britney, a squeezed calligraphic script whose curves hold a thread-like line. Nunito Sans gives it a soft, open-mouthed partner, and that gentle handoff is the pair's best trick, better for brief copy.
gen-fs-chubbo-fs-gambetta: Marker-tip letters, round and friendly, with no contrast at all in Chubbo. And Gambetta follows with a bookish serif whose stroke weight ebbs and flows, so the flat heading and the graceful text feel like different voices.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-almendra: Chubbo draws every bend as if with a marker tip, casual and inviting, with a smooth path all the way around. Almendra's deep, tall lowercase gives a dignified text serif texture over many lines.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-epunda-slab: Soft, plain-lined marker letters up top, casual and inviting, set against a body with taller rounded forms. Epunda Slab, a text serif with a gaping c, adds a dignified edge.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-graduate: Chubbo opens with friendly, marker-drawn letters that curve smoothly and feel casual and welcoming from the first word. Graduate, a serif with generous space between letters and no stem contrast, makes a dignified, bookish read.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Chubbo draws crossbars as thick as its stems, with a moderate lowercase and a marker-tip feel that is casual and inviting. But Noto Sans Buginese has the taller lowercase and open chalk-arc mouths, which is where it does its best work.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Marker-tip curves, smooth all the way round, define Chubbo. Noto Sans Syriac adds tall, bulb-like lowercase bowls and wide, easy s turns in a modern sans-serif, so the two read as friendly and approachable.
gen-fs-chubbo-gf-port-lligat-slab: Round, marker-drawn, and easygoing, Chubbo leads with an inviting casual look. Port Lligat Slab, a literary serif with wide porthole counters and curves with room to breathe, is the pair's strongest card.
gen-fs-chubbo-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab reads precise and structured, its middle zone dominating each line. Beneath Chubbo's marker-traced heading, a longer passage would feel organized and open, with throats on a, c, e and s that stay easy to follow.
